Fixed: Achievement [Doyen] cannot be unlocked.
Fixed: Nightmare mode cannot be unlocked

For a variety of reasons, the new version of Steam hasn't been updated and released (though it's been in beta for a long time), but it's kept you waiting.

-------------------------------------------------------
At present, the Steam version of ver 1.0.2.21,
the new version of Ver 1.0.4.30, is mainly updated as follows:

1 increased endless mode (new adventure mechanism, weather and monster enhancement, 10 levels of content).
2 changed some of the weapons.
3 repaired many BUG
4 optimize operation handle and handle delay.
-------------------------------------------------------

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28417448/ba329a5a9ecf52f355c5adc8d2d933a518a67397.png[/img]

The following is a detailed version of the change (which can also be viewed in the update log of the game):
1.0.4.30
Change: In Adventure mode, another explorable room will show after you clean up a monster room.
Change: [Perfect Block] will no longer refresh Invincibility time.  
Change: [Torrent] crossbow has been weakened but other crossbows strengthened。
Newly Added: The Endless mode and its leaderboard need to be unlocked after you pass the Ultimate difficulty. 
Fixed: Some wrongly displayed maps and special effects have been fixed. 
Fixed: Be unable to press OK button after PVP mode ends has been fixed. 
Fixed: We have fixed abnormal forced closure of game process, reloading stuck and etc.  
Fixed: The Talent page can be selected by mouse now. 
Fixed: Abnormal archive loading has been fixed. 
Fixed: Abnormal click situation of the Talent page has been fixed. 
Optimized: The animation playback collision, button delay of the handle as well as occasional monster room cleaning stuck have been optimized.

1.0.2.24
Fix: the achievement is not synchronized due to flash back

1.0.2.23
Fix: Part of the error due to a forced shutdown of the game
Fix: PVP mode no longer shows the difficulty
Fix: Portal changed to cycle triggered

1.0.2.21
Fix: Portal changed to cycle triggered:Abnormality caused by rapid and continuous use of the alchemy Desk 

1.0.2.20
Fix: Portal changed to cycle triggered: Fireball explosion will not cause harm
Fix: Portal changed to cycle triggered:Occasional attacks on non-existent objects

1.0.2.16
Repair the WinXp & Win7 execute error

1.0.2.14
Optimization: make the operation smooth
Fix:cannot be return to main panel with mouse clicks at the end of PVP.
Fix:In the online mode, when the teammates leave and the host exit game, the screen that will always be black.
--------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you!

Version 1.0.2.0
Newly added: Online adventure mode
Newly added: Online Versus mode
Newly added: Three new weapons
Newly added: Three online achievements

Adjustment: [Ornament] option has been added into the menu of [Soul Collector].
Adjustment: The overall BOSS difficulty of the Pandora increases and the number of monsters will also be affected by the number of players. 
Adjustment: Pandora’s initial equipment has been changed to 4-level novice weapons and 1-level ornament, which increases Pandora’s attribute damage (such as poisonous and burning damages).
Adjustment: Two 4-level equipment can also be integrated, and then an enchant attribute will be attached. 
Adjustment: Cancel the upper limit of the enhanced furnace.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Other details:
[Assassin]’s dismemberment marks need to be built after going behind the enemy and accumulate for a while. 
[Sword of Sacrifice] can stock up blood by eating food with health points overflowed. 
For move changes for one-handed sword, please refer to Adventurer’s Manual. 
The attack frequency while using Block gets higher after throwing out the Shiv.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note:
For the old Version 1.0.0.6 has been transferred to 1006 branch (Test code: 000000001006), players who want to keep playing the old PC version can switch branches freely, except that the achievements display is not correct, the archives are the same. 

How to switch the test branch?
1. Select game in the Steam game list, right-click and select attributes in the pop-up menu. 
2. Click the test bar and enter the corresponding test code. 
3. Then press down the check code button to the right. 
4. There’s a drop-down list in the upper left side, you can select the newly added branch there. 
5. Close the panel and wait for the update. 

How to switch back to the original branch?
If it is the default version, you can start from step 4 above and select no test in the drop-down list. 

Occasionally, the room fails to join, and it can be recreated after leaving the room.

If you have any questions, you can leave a message to the forum.

Finally, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update Plan or Trend for Future Version after 0.5.5.x
notes.content:
1. Customize the Handle Keys
2. Archive (Save the last game. The game will be saved once every time you enter the next level, which can be archived only after the death of the player. )
3. Benefits in Ranking List (The achievement will be reset and archived weekly in the ranking list. Then, a certain soul value will be offered to the top 100 players.)
4. Special Moves to Add (incomplete currently)
5. Increase Random Events (Extensions to adventurer events and additional events that appear randomly in dungeon, more gambling events and emergencies, etc.)
6. New Equipment
7. New Types of Weapons
8. New Monsters
9. Increase the Challenge of BOSS
10. New BOSS
11. Perfect Misfortune Talent (Here, misfortune cannot only increase the random monster features but also the player's random ability upgrade)
12. More Types of Challenge Events in Challenge Room
13 New Achievements & New Branch Tasks
14. Complete Unlock System (each adventure accumulation of the soul value can be used to unlock the new avatar, equipment, branch tasks, new blessing attributes, etc.)
15. Improve the basic layout of the room, such as the traps (Thorns, arrows, laser, deceleration strip and more. With the number of the traps increases, the number of monsters or density will be reduced accordingly.), and increase the type of damage (For some traps may attack indiscriminately after they are damaged by players or monsters)

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Red Obsidian Remnant Structure Update on June 1st
notes.content:
Red Obsidian Remnant Structure Update on June 1st

Hello, everyone! Thank you very much for your supports and feedbacks. In order to create a better game experience, we’ll make a few adjustments by adding new systems and event contents, which will bring about more fresh experiences. The scene of the game and lighting will also be adjusted. Frankly speaking, the game screen part is not what we’re good at. But we’ll try our best to make it better.

 [img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28417448/f1726ddcf40ef2bd5acae30ff749a5a5f94fb739.png[/img]

Blessing: The emergence of all equipment will probably obtain blessings from a random level. Then, weapons will be attached with a special effect or attribute. When you encounter the Broken Sword Blessing Spot in the Antique Room, you can purchase and upgrade the effect. 

Adjustment and Newly Added Events: We’ve adjusted all the altars and events in the Antique Room and newly added Swap Spot for blessing and barter. 

 [img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28417448/4b98c5d0d2f460d38b5bc8baa99888ce6e0649eb.png[/img]

Chest: We adjust the output of all chests by adding new chest to create output difference of the chests. But, it’s likely to find advanced equipment in any of the chests, which will be full of surprises. 
 
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28417448/a1ff30b7f16137daf52405911a38d246761b68d0.png[/img]

Level Page: Along with the increase of the depth of the dungeon, more and more rooms will be added and only one group of monsters will appear in the Combat Room. The overall clearance time will not be longer and more random event rooms will appear accordingly. 

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28417448/2147cea4031b83ce046d7f7e255ebc58da576521.png[/img] 

Others: We’ve adjusted and added some talents. And the extra bonus system of the Combat Room will be changed to the system of the Badge Challenge. 

In addition to add new equipment and monsters, we’ll consider to re-create scenes and add traps in the following update versions. Thanks very much for your support. We expect more suggestions and feedbacks from you.
